about: Repair study (docs/deferred.md D9): one fault per case, injected by manip_sim/fault_injection.py into a starting specification that plans and passes the grader. Rows are found by `match`, so entries survive row reordering; an entry that does not apply to a starting specification raises FaultNotApplicable. A fault is kept only if qualification shows the faulty specification fails to plan. `expect` is our prediction of the typed failure, logged and never sent to a model. Point and axis names: pour tea uses the sim pools (assets/objects/*/candidates.json); insert marker uses the grounded pools of outputs/grounding/insert_marker_gt_opus1, as run_authoring_ablation.TASKS does.

faults.expect: goal region in collision: no collision-free carry goal, teapot body against the mug
carry goal in collision (handle over the mug), or the pour rejects the entry
faults.note: the 11/05 hardware failure; regenerating call #3 keeps call #2's point

faults.expect: pour stage CompileError: entry outside its path z band (beyond the start projection budget)
faults.note: clearance 'large' is the top of the ladder and no typed action narrows a clearance: the typed conditions can fix it only with reemit_stage (call #3 writes the carry again) or by loosening the pour's path band; a refused widen/relax on this row is the action set, not the feedback

faults.expect: empty goal set: upright contradicts the tilted pour row
no path within the planner budget, or no IK at the pour goal
faults.note: candidate only: qualification decides whether it is infeasible

faults.expect: insert goal in collision: the lower end against the cup floor
faults.note: insert has no natural too-small clearance (the opening is free space); applies only to a starting spec whose insert depth is a 'below' term

faults.expect: insert goal in collision: the marker's middle at the insert depth puts its end through the cup floor
faults.note: grounded marker points (outputs/grounding/insert_marker_gt_opus1): body_center, body_tip, tip_center; the starting spec inserts by body_tip

faults.expect: insert stage CompileError: entry attitude outside its path rotation band
faults.note: turns the transport goal's aligned axis 90 deg away; grounded marker axes are canonical (up/front/lateral)

faults.expect: empty goal set: shaft both parallel and perpendicular to the cup's up
faults.note: contradicts a starting insert subgoal row 'marker.front_axis parallel cup.up_axis' (gt_opus1); revisit against the qualified starting spec

faults.expect: no path within the planner budget
faults.note: candidate only: qualification decides whether it is infeasible

faults.expect: insert stage rejects the entry the transport goal hands it: the upright marker's lateral axis is horizontal, the insert path now wants it along the cup's up
faults.note: replaces insert_handoff_axis, whose edit contradicted the transport stage's own path row (a within-stage contradiction, not a handoff)

faults.expect: no path within the planner budget (insert path rotation held to +-5 deg)
faults.note: candidate only: qualification decides whether it is infeasible
